title: US Welcomes Italy into Pax Silica Initiative
author: Office of the Spokesperson
summary:
Office of the Spokesperson

US Welcomes Italy into Pax Silica Initiative

Media Note

July 31, 2026

Today, the United States welcomed Italy into the Pax Silica initiative.

Italy signed the Pax Silica Declaration in Brindisi, Italy, officially acknowledging Italy’s participation in the initiative. The United States and Italy affirmed their commitment to leveraging Italy’s advanced manufacturing expertise to strengthen critical minerals and semiconductor supply chain resilience.

Italy is the 25th Pax Silica Declaration signatory. Pax Silica is a positive-sum partnership of economies committed to safeguarding competitiveness and prosperity.

For media inquiries, please submit questions here, and stay updated by following @UnderSecE on X.

For more information, visit Pax Silica.
